title: Suits: C8b purples, circuit blues, hex plate variations
desc: C8b's carbon weave (kept) in three other purples, with C8b as before for comparison; T1 circuit rebuilt with darker plates and brighter traces in three blue pairs; three new hex-plate builds of T2. Same C8b shape and suit-up; the reveal light is each take's corps colour on every piece.

takes.name: C8b (as before)
takes.facts: Violet carbon weave, unchanged; reference for the purples

takes.name: C8b in royal purple
takes.facts: Carbon weave recipe unchanged; royal purple (0.2, 0, 1.0): bluer and deeper than C8b's violet; reveal band, seams and ring royal purple

takes.name: C8b in deep plum
takes.facts: Carbon weave recipe unchanged; deep plum (0.15, 0, 0.42): the darkest purple, dim plates, dim seams

takes.name: C8b in ultraviolet
takes.facts: Carbon weave recipe unchanged; ultraviolet (0.06, 0, 1.0): blue-violet edge of purple

takes.name: Circuit: navy + electric blue
takes.facts: Near-black navy plate; bright electric-blue traces on an offset grid with square pads

takes.name: Circuit: steel black + cobalt
takes.facts: Blue-black steel plate; deep cobalt traces in two crossed grids (dense maze), no pads

takes.name: Circuit: indigo + azure
takes.facts: Indigo-black plate; sparse azure traces with big ringed pads

takes.name: Hex: fine honeycomb
takes.facts: Red; true hexagons 3 px wide, nearly flat, every gap glows steadily

takes.name: Hex: big domed tiles
takes.facts: Red; 8 px hex tiles domed in deep relief, dark gaps, a lit hex outline inset in each tile

takes.name: Hex: twinkling cells
takes.facts: Red; 5 px bevelled hex cells, faint gaps, random cells light up and fade on a 3 s cycle
